description:
Deployment-manager's release orchestrator always calls LPBS /verify in lightweight mode (version and sha512 match). The deep mode (S3 object HEAD plus presign-generation check) is only reachable post-hoc via `deployment-manager releases verify --deep`. For critical releases, operators should be able to request exhaustive verification in a single `releases start` call instead of a two-step flow.

Scope of work:
- Add a `Deep bool` field to releases.StartRequest in scenarios/deployment-manager/api/releases/types.go.
- Thread it through deployments.DeployRequest and deployState to deployVerifyUpdateEndpoints, which already receives the LPBSVerifyRequest with a Deep field but currently hardcodes false.
- Add `--deep` flag to the CLI `releases start` command in scenarios/deployment-manager/cli/releases/commands.go, matching the existing `--deep` on `releases verify`.
- Extend handler + orchestrator tests to cover: default (Deep=false) uses lightweight, --deep=true propagates through to the LPBSVerifyRequest per platform.

Out of scope:
- Changing the default verification mode for all releases.
- Changing the LPBS verify endpoint contract.
name: deployment-manager-release-deep-verify-option
title: Add --deep Option To releases start For Exhaustive Post-Publish Verify
